metadata.source: S. Zahedpour, J. K. Wahlstrand, H. M. Milchberg. Measurement of the nonlinear refractive index of air constituents at mid-infrared wavelengths. Opt. Lett. 40, 5794-5795 (2015) (https://doi.org/10.1364/OL.40.005794); downloaded from refractiveindex.info
metadata.description:
40 fs. Single-shot supercontinuum spectral interferometry. Room temperature, atmospheric pressure.
For long pulses, the effective nonlinearity coefficient can be calculated by adding the rotational contribution to the reported instantaneous n2: n2,eff = n2 + n2,rot, where n2,rot = 54×10-24 m2/W.
